title: Non-backwards-compatible column rename breaks old instances mid-rollout
source_note: Failure pattern (a schema change shipped in one step with its code, so old instances still serving during a rolling deploy query a column that no longer exists) is the classic expand/contract migration violation discussed in GitHub's schema-migration engineering writeups. All services, commit hashes, log lines, metrics, and timestamps are fabricated for evaluation.
incident_report: Since ~22:01 UTC about half of invoice-creation requests are failing. A billing-api deploy with a database migration started at 22:00 and is still rolling out. Reads seem fine.

signal_lines.msg: billing-api a7b8c9d rolling out; migration 20261117 applied (rename invoices.amount -> amount_cents)
old instances: column invoices.amount does not exist (SQLSTATE 42703); invoice writes failing
~50% of invoice creation requests failing during the rollout
rollout at 6/12 hosts; version skew is causing a schema mismatch
rollout completed to all hosts; errors cleared once every instance is on the new code

deploys.summary: rename invoices.amount -> amount_cents (migration + code in one release)

ground_truth.root_cause: Deploy a7b8c9d renamed the invoices.amount column to amount_cents in a single step - the migration and the code change shipped together. During the rolling deploy, instances still on the old code queried invoices.amount, which no longer existed, so ~50% of invoice writes (the fraction on old instances) failed with 'column does not exist'. This is an expand/contract violation: the rename was not backwards-compatible with the in-flight old version. Errors cleared once every instance was on the new code.
evidence_path: deploy a7b8c9d at 22:00 applies migration 20261117 renaming invoices.amount, rolling out
billing-api ERROR: old instances hit 'column invoices.amount does not exist' (42703)
~50% of invoice writes fail during the rollout, matching the old/new instance split
schema_errors_per_s spikes then falls as the rollout completes
errors clear once all 12 hosts are on the new code
ground_truth.fix: Complete the rollout to stop the bleeding (done). Split such changes: add amount_cents alongside amount, deploy code that writes both and reads the new one, backfill, then drop amount in a later release. Add a migration lint that blocks non-backwards-compatible renames.
